title: public/ is 103 MB; demos folder 89 MB with five 9-22 MB videos plus an `-orig` master
impact: du: public/demos 89,204 KB. scorpio-demo.mp4 22.5 MB, scorpio-demo.webm 21.0 MB, scorpio-demo-orig.mp4 20.2 MB, landing-demo-v2.webm 17.8 MB, landing-demo-v2.mp4 9.3 MB (raw/public-large.txt). These ship in every deploy/standalone trace, inflate Firebase Hosting uploads and git clone size, and the -orig master is not referenced by src/.
recommendation: Delete unreferenced masters (scorpio-demo-orig.mp4, landing-demo-v2.* if unused), re-encode demos to <=5 MB at 720p (H.264 CRF 28 / AV1), and host large video on a CDN/Storage bucket.

title: Landing page embeds a 22 MB mp4 via <video src> with no preload or poster
impact: `<video src="/demos/scorpio-demo.mp4" controls ...>` without `preload="none"`/`metadata` or poster; Safari/iOS and some Chrome configs may prefetch large ranges and compete with LCP resources on the home page. src/app/demos/page.tsx:L78 does use preload="metadata" and a poster, so this is inconsistent.
recommendation: Add `preload="none"` + `poster`, lazy-mount via IntersectionObserver, serve the compressed rendition.

title: demo-carousel uses preload="auto" for a video
impact: L202 `preload="auto"` while L165 and L260 use metadata; carousel is dynamically imported (system-demos.tsx:L8) but still downloads the full clip eagerly once mounted.
recommendation: Use preload="metadata" and load active slide only.

title: Multi-MB images served raw: headshot-sage.jpg 3.1 MB via , og-image.png 2.6 MB, plan.jpg 1.4 MB
impact: raw/public-sizes.txt: headshot-sage.jpg 3,032 KB; og-image.png 2,584 KB (referenced src/app/layout.tsx:L115 and README); og-image-pink.png 1.2 MB; several 450-670 KB dashboard PNGs. Social crawlers (WhatsApp/Twitter) often reject og images >300 KB-1 MB, and the About page hero downloads 3 MB.
recommendation: Resize/convert to WebP/AVIF (headshot <=150 KB, OG 1200x630 <=300 KB JPEG) and render with next/image.

title: 6 raw elements bypass next/image (no resizing/lazy/AVIF)
impact: eslint @next/next/no-img-element at about-client.tsx:L229, request-access/page.tsx:L341, teacher/submission/grade/page.tsx:L557, feature-section.tsx:L237 and L276, ui/macbook-scroll.tsx:L166 (6 hits in raw/eslint-bug-rules.txt). next.config.mjs:L5-L6 has an empty `images: {}` so no formats/remotePatterns configured.
recommendation: Replace with next/image where the source is static; for user-uploaded blob/Storage URLs add remotePatterns and keep with loading=lazy + width/height.

title: Eight next/font families loaded globally (322 woff2 files emitted in .next)
impact: layout.tsx instantiates Plus_Jakarta_Sans, Lora, IBM_Plex_Mono, Inter, IBM_Plex_Sans, PT_Serif, Atkinson_Hyperlegible, Roboto_Mono (+ Alan Sans in deps) with multiple weights (e.g. L31 seven weights). `find .next -name '*.woff2'` => 322 files. Fonts are user-selectable themes, so each unused family still adds CSS variables and preloads.
recommendation: Set `preload: false` and `display: 'swap'` for non-default fonts, or load a user-chosen font on demand; use variable fonts with a single weight range; drop @fontsource-variable/alan-sans if unused.

title: Next infers wrong workspace root (parent lockfile); standalone output nests under source/learn/scorpio
impact: build.txt L5-L9: 'detected multiple lockfiles and selected /Users/pradeepmahdevu/package-lock.json as root'. The build produced `.next/standalone/source/learn/scorpio/...` (seen in raw/test-security.txt haste collision). Tracing may include unrelated files and the standalone server path differs between machines/CI.
recommendation: Set `outputFileTracingRoot: path.join(__dirname)` in next.config.mjs and remove the stray parent lockfile.

title: mathjs and mathlive installed but never imported (README advertises mathlive)
impact: raw/dep-usage-check.txt: `mathjs -> referenced in 0 files`, `mathlive -> 0 files`; README.md says the Visual Math Builder is 'powered by mathlive'. No bundle impact, but install size (mathlive ships fonts/sounds) and misleading docs.
recommendation: Remove both (or actually lazy-load mathlive in math-builder-modal via next/dynamic).

title: framer-motion statically imported in ~54 files, plus duplicate `motion` package in 8 files
impact: 54 files import 'framer-motion' (incl. login, signup, forgot-password, landing, route-progress-bar in the root layout) and 8 import 'motion/react' (package.json:L61 and L66 both present). framer-motion adds ~30-50 KB gz to many first-load bundles; two APIs for one library.
recommendation: Standardise on `motion` (m + LazyMotion with domAnimation) and remove framer-motion; keep AnimatePresence only where needed; use CSS transitions for simple fades.

title: Positive/Info: heavy libs are mostly lazy-loaded; cobe-globe is dead
impact: react-globe.gl is loaded with next/dynamic ssr:false (L7); tiptap is dynamic in student/notebook/page.tsx:L76; recharts cost chart dynamic in landing/pricing.tsx:L12; DemoCarousel, SettingsDialog, SustainabilityContent dynamic. `three` is only a peer of react-globe.gl (no direct imports). BUT: feature-section.tsx:L7 statically imports scorpio-globe (wrapper, small), recharts is imported statically in dashboard/student-progress-chart.tsx:L12 and landing/layer-efficacy-chart.tsx:L12, katex statically in math-input.tsx:L5 (used by 3 pages), and cobe-globe.tsx (imports `cobe`) is not imported anywhere.
recommendation: Delete cobe-globe.tsx and the `cobe` dep if confirmed unused; wrap student-progress-chart and layer-efficacy-chart in next/dynamic; dynamic-import math-input on the assignment pages.

title: vercel CLI and unused packages in root dependencies (vercel, firebase-functions, baseline-browser-mapping, sib-api-v3-sdk, @vercel/*, @polar-sh/nextjs)
impact: `vercel ^50.39.0` (L90) is a ~200+ MB dev CLI with 0 references; firebase-functions has 0 imports in src/ (only functions/); baseline-browser-mapping 0 refs; @vercel/analytics, @vercel/speed-insights, @polar-sh/nextjs, sib-api-v3-sdk 0 refs (raw/dep-usage-check.txt). firebase-admin is imported only from 33 server-side files (src/app/api, src/lib, src/proxy.ts; none has a use client directive), so no client leakage found. Production Docker/standalone installs still pull these.
recommendation: Move vercel to devDependencies or remove (deploy is Firebase); remove firebase-functions, baseline-browser-mapping, sib-api-v3-sdk, @vercel/*, @polar-sh/nextjs from root; keep firebase-admin (server) in dependencies.

title: Teacher dashboard loads every course, assignment, student and all submissions client-side without limits
impact: L106-L119 fetch all courses/assignments/students for the teacher; L138-L148 fetch every submission for all assignments in 30-id chunks (no limit, no pagination, no aggregation counters). Cost scales with total submissions: a teacher with 150 students x 40 assignments = 6000 reads per dashboard load. Only 17 `limit()` calls exist repo-wide (raw grep); client pages use none except page-client.tsx:L170 limit(3).
recommendation: Maintain per-assignment counters (submissionCount/gradedCount) updated by Cloud Function and read those; paginate or `limit()` the recent-submissions list; use getCountFromServer for totals.

title: Gradebook reads all submissions for selected course/assignments unbounded
impact: L113 query where assignmentId == selected has no limit; L121-L127 `in` chunks of 30 fetch all submissions for all assignments (comment calls it 'critical for performance' but it fetches entire collection slices). teacher/grades/student/page.tsx:L66-L80 repeats the pattern per student.
recommendation: Add orderBy+limit pagination, cache results in state, and consider a denormalised grades collection.

title: N+1 reads inside a realtime listener: one getDoc per submission on every snapshot
impact: onSnapshot over all of a student's submissions (L36) then `Promise.all(snapshot.docs.map(... getDoc(doc(db,'assignments',data.assignmentId))))` (L40-L45); the comment even says 'Cache these maybe?'. Every grade update on any submission re-fetches every assignment. Same pattern risks quota burn at class scale.
recommendation: Store assignmentTitle/courseId on the submission at write time (server-side) or cache assignments by id in a Map outside the listener; add limit/pagination.

title: Admin analytics reads the full organizations collection unbounded
impact: `getDocs(query(collection(db,'organizations'), orderBy('name')))` with no limit; admin only, but grows with tenants.
recommendation: Add limit(100) + search/pagination.

title: Build output has no route size table; recharts zero-size chart warning during prerender; bundle analyzer absent
impact: Next 16 `next build` output lists routes without First Load JS, and the repo has no @next/next/bundle-analyzer, so I1 (10 heaviest routes) cannot be derived from raw/build.txt. build.txt also logs 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' during static generation and two 'Retrying 1/3' compile messages.
recommendation: Add `@next/bundle-analyzer` (ANALYZE=true) or `next experimental-analyze`; give ResponsiveContainer min dimensions/initialDimension.

title: I1 / I6 not fully executed
impact: I1: route-level first-load JS unavailable from build output; largest chunks in the stale local .next/static/chunks (3343-*.js 327 KB, 7508b87c 288 KB, bdfe9574 265 KB, d3ac728e 264 KB, 9826 222 KB, framework 190 KB; raw/largest-chunks.txt) are raw (uncompressed) sizes and cannot be mapped to routes (no app-build-manifest.json). I6: Lighthouse not run: needs `npm run start` with production Firebase config; no emulator/test account is available and the rules forbid calling production services.
recommendation: Run bundle analyzer in CI; run Lighthouse against a preview deploy with a test account.

title: StudentLayout and TeacherLayout statically bundle NavigationChatbot (katex 73.9 KB gz + react-markdown 47.3 KB gz) into all 21 app routes, and Vault pages bundle KaTeX twice (147.1 KB gz)
impact: Bundle analyzer (raw/bundle-analyzer-client.json, raw/bundle-analyzer-routes.json) shows static/chunks/d3ac728e (katex.mjs, 258.2 KB parsed / 73.9 KB gz) and static/chunks/2831 (react-markdown + remark-gfm + rehype-katex, 158.1 KB parsed / 47.3 KB gz) are initial chunks on app/student/layout and app/teacher/layout via NavigationChatbot (src/app/student/layout.tsx:L5, src/app/teacher/layout.tsx:L6). Meanwhile react-katex (student/vault/page.tsx:L31, teacher/vault/page.tsx:L48, workspace-preview-pages.tsx:L30) requires CJS katex.js (static/chunks/bdfe9574, 258.7 KB parsed / 73.2 KB gz), so /teacher/vault (647.6 KB gz), /student/vault (635.5 KB gz) and /demos/teacher (549.7 KB gz) load two complete copies of KaTeX (516.9 KB parsed / 147.1 KB gz).
recommendation: Wrap NavigationChatbot in next/dynamic(..., { ssr: false }) and defer loading MarkdownRenderer/KaTeX until the chat drawer is opened; replace react-katex with MarkdownRenderer or alias katex to a single module entry in next.config.mjs.

title: Providers sets needsAuth=true on almost all public pages, eagerly loading @firebase/firestore (82.3 KB gz, 94.6% unused) and reCAPTCHA Enterprise (360 KiB) on /pricing and /login
impact: src/components/providers.tsx:L14 sets `needsAuth = pathname !== '/' && pathname !== '/demos/teacher'`, causing AuthProvider (src/contexts/auth-context.tsx:L39-L43) to import @/lib/firebase and firebase/firestore on public routes like /pricing. Because src/lib/firebase.ts:L23-L64 initializes getFirestore, getStorage, and initializeAppCheck(ReCaptchaEnterpriseProvider) at module top-level, Lighthouse (raw/lighthouse-pricing-mobile.json, raw/lighthouse-login-mobile.json) records 360 KiB transfer for recaptcha__en.js (207 KiB unused) and 84.5 KiB for @firebase/firestore (94.6% unused), pushing mobile TTI to 9.6 s on /pricing.
recommendation: Restrict needsAuth in src/components/providers.tsx:L14 to authenticated/auth-flow routes (/student, /teacher, /admin, /login, /signup, /join), split src/lib/firebase.ts so Firestore/Storage/AppCheck initialize lazily on first use, and defer initializeAppCheck until an AI or protected call occurs.

title: /login blocks rendering behind authLoading (<LoadingSpinner fullPage />) and an opacity:0 motion wrapper, causing a 10.0 s mobile LCP (Lighthouse score 73)
impact:
Lighthouse mobile on /login (raw/lighthouse-login-mobile.json) records Performance score 73, FCP 1.1 s (1,057 ms), LCP 10.0 s (9,993 ms), TBT 100 ms, CLS 0 (desktop score 90, LCP 2.0 s). src/app/login/page.tsx:L102-L104 renders only while useAuth().loading is true (waiting for dynamic import of @/lib/firebase + firebase/firestore + AppCheck and onAuthChange in auth-context.tsx:L39-L55), and then mounts the form inside (L209-L214), delaying the LCP element (
Welcome Back
) to 10.0 s on mobile.

title: Landing page (/) #scorpio-intro splash dialog and paused opacity:0 hero animation delay mobile LCP to 5.4 s (Lighthouse score 79), and HomeChatbot eagerly loads KaTeX + react-markdown (124 KiB)
impact: Lighthouse mobile on / (raw/lighthouse-home-mobile.json) records Performance score 79, FCP 1.4 s (1,355 ms), LCP 5.4 s (5,432 ms), TBT 130 ms, CLS 0 (desktop score 98, LCP 1.2 s). Lighthouse lcp-breakdown-insight identifies <a id='dashboard-preview'> (LandingHero.tsx:L48) with elementRenderDelay 1,953 ms: loading-screen.tsx:L31-L44 opens #scorpio-intro modal on parse, and home-reveal.module.css:L24-L30 pauses animations while open and runs a 1s reveal-preview animation from opacity:0. Additionally, HomeChatbot (home-interactions.tsx:L7-L10) uses next/dynamic with ssr:false, downloading d3ac728e (katex.mjs, 75.4 KiB) and 2831 (react-markdown, 48.6 KiB) immediately on hydration.
recommendation: Remove the blocking #scorpio-intro modal splash (or do not gate the hero LCP element behind opacity:0 / animation-play-state:paused) and load the LandingChatbot chunk only when the user clicks/hovers the chat launcher button.

title: Plus_Jakarta_Sans, Lora, and IBM_Plex_Mono omit subsets: ['latin'], generating 141 Google Font .woff2 files across all Unicode ranges and 20 build-time network timeouts
impact: In src/app/layout.tsx:L15-L35, Plus_Jakarta_Sans, Lora, and IBM_Plex_Mono (7 weights x 2 styles) omit `subsets: ['latin']`. While preload:false on 6 of 8 fonts prevents initial preload links (next-font-manifest.json preloads only 2 woff2 files), omitting subsets emits 141 Google Font .woff2 files (+ 20 KaTeX woff2 = 161 woff2 files, 3.0 MB in .next/static/media/) covering cyrillic-ext/cyrillic/vietnamese/latin-ext/latin, bloats static/css/f51d6fff944d3fdb.css, and causes 20 `read ETIMEDOUT / Retrying 1/3...` stalls during `npm run build` (raw/clean-clone-log.txt:L371-L430).
recommendation: Add `subsets: ['latin']` to Plus_Jakarta_Sans, Lora, and IBM_Plex_Mono in src/app/layout.tsx:L15-L35 and reduce IBM_Plex_Mono weights from 7 to ['400', '500', '700'].
